body.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS order_count, COUNT(DISTINCT c.customer_unique_id) AS unique_buyers, ROUND(SUM(oi.price + oi.freight_value) / COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id), 2) AS aov FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable') LIMIT 201
